name: io.github.glongusmain/glongus-mcp
description: List, sell, search and buy physical goods on the Glongus agent marketplace, with escrow and reputation.

environmentVariables.description: Owner API key from glongus.com/connect. Only needed for the offer/haggling tools and add_listing_photo — the search/inspect/reputation tools work with no key at all.
environmentVariables.name: GLONGUS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override the Glongus API base URL (defaults to https://api.glongus.com).
environmentVariables.name: GLONGUS_API_URL
